basic_details.job_title: AIIMS Bhubaneswar Laboratory Technician III Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Bhubaneswar is filling one Laboratory Technician-III post (UR) on a purely temporary basis in the DHR-ICMR DIAMONDS research project. Applications must be emailed to [email protected] before 25 November 2026, 5.00 pm, and candidates then appear for a walk-in interview on 27 November 2026 at 10:00 AM.

age_limit.details: The age limit printed in the notice is 30 Years. The notice does not print a date for counting age.

qualification.details: Essential: Intermediate or 12th pass in science subjects and 2 years' diploma in medical laboratory technician from a recognized board with one-year work experience. Or: One year DMLT plus two years' work experience in a recognized organization. B.Sc. (MLT) Degree shall be treated as 3 years' experience. Desirable: Experience of one year in carrying out laboratory work related to molecular diagnostics in Govt., Autonomous, PSU, recognized organization. | The age limit printed in the notice is 30 Years. The notice does not print a date for counting age. | Relaxation for SC, ST and OBC candidates is given against reserved posts only. Relaxation is admissible for SC/ST/OBC candidates, Retrenched Government Employees, Departmental candidates (including projects) and Ex-servicemen, in accordance with instructions issued by the Central Government from time to time. Age concession to the extent of service rendered in other research projects is also admissible for experienced and skilled persons. | The post is for 12 Months (Initially).

important_instructions: These are tenure vacancies under a funded project and are not employment on the AIIMS Bhubaneswar pay roll. Employment will be automatically terminated on completion of the project. There is no liability for permanent employment on AIIMS, Bhubaneswar or the Principal Investigator, and candidates have no right to claim permanent employment based on this job. No TA/DA will be given. A candidate working in a Government/Semi Government/PSU institution must have a No Objection Certificate. AIIMS Bhubaneswar reserves the right to terminate the candidate with a prior notice of 1 month if performance is not satisfactory. For the discipline-specific eligibility of the post, refer to the official notification.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Bhubaneswar Laboratory Technician-III at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

rows.details: All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Bhubaneswar
Intermediate or 12th pass in science subjects and 2 years' diploma in medical laboratory technician, with one-year work experience (or one year DMLT plus two years' work experience)
Department of Pathology & Lab Medicine, AIIMS, Bhubaneswar

content_sections.heading: About the Organisation and Project
content_sections.text: The notice is issued by All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Bhubaneswar, Sijua, Post- Dumduma, Bhubaneswar 751019. The post is in the research project titled "DHR-ICMR Advance Medical Oncology Diagnostic Services (DIAMONDS) under HTA In, Pilot Research Project", run under Functional Principal Investigator Dr. Pritinanda Mishra, Professor, Department of Pathology, AIIMS, Bhubaneswar.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Email the application to [email protected] before 25.11.2026, 5.00 pm. The notice does not print a subject line for the email. Use the "Format for Application" printed on page 3 of the notice, duly filled. Send with it the original certificates of educational qualifications, the experience certificate, a passport size photo and a set of self-attested photocopies of all documents. Appear in person for the walk-in interview on 27.11.2026 at 10:00 AM. Contact: Dr Pritinanda Mishra, Functional Principal Investigator, Professor, Department of Pathology & Lab Medicine, AIIMS, Bhubaneswar. Email: [email protected]

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Essential: Intermediate or 12th pass in science subjects and 2 years' diploma in medical laboratory technician from a recognized board with one-year work experience. Or: One year DMLT plus two years' work experience in a recognized organization. B.Sc. (MLT) Degree shall be treated as 3 years' experience. Desirable: Experience of one year in carrying out laboratory work related to molecular diagnostics in Govt., Autonomous, PSU, recognized organization. The age limit printed in the notice is 30 Years. The notice does not print a date for counting age. Relaxation for SC, ST and OBC candidates is given against reserved posts only. Relaxation is admissible for SC/ST/OBC candidates, Retrenched Government Employees, Departmental candidates (including projects) and Ex-servicemen, in accordance with instructions issued by the Central Government from time to time. Age concession to the extent of service rendered in other research projects is also admissible for experienced and skilled persons. The post is for 12 Months (Initially).

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Duly filled application form in the prescribed format Original certificates of educational qualifications Experience certificate Passport size photo Set of self-attested photocopies of all documents No Objection Certificate, if working in a Government/Semi Government/PSU institution

faq.question: Q1. How many Laboratory Technician-III posts are vacant at AIIMS Bhubaneswar?
faq.answer: There is 01 post, and it is marked (UR).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The application must be emailed before 25.11.2026, 5.00 pm.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for Laboratory Technician-III?
faq.answer: Intermediate or 12th pass in science subjects and 2 years' diploma in medical laboratory technician from a recognized board with one-year work experience; or one year DMLT plus two years' work experience in a recognized organization. B.Sc. (MLT) Degree is treated as 3 years' experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The notice gives the age limit as 30 Years, with relaxation for SC/ST/OBC against reserved posts, Retrenched Government Employees, Departmental candidates (including projects), Ex-servicemen and project-service concession.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary?
faq.answer: The monthly salary is Rs 20000/- + 20%HRA, for an initial duration of 12 months.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Email the duly filled application form in the prescribed format, with a passport size photo, original certificates, the experience certificate and self-attested photocopies, to [email protected] before 25.11.2026, 5.00 pm.

faq.question: Q7. When and where is the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 27.11.2026 at 10:00 AM, and the interview location is given as the Department of Pathology & Lab Medicine, AIIMS, Bhubaneswar.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. It is a purely temporary tenure post under a funded project, not on the AIIMS Bhubaneswar pay roll, and it ends automatically when the project is completed.

faq.question: Q9. Is a No Objection Certificate needed?
faq.answer: Yes, if the candidate is working in a Government/Semi Government/PSU institution.

faq.question: Q10. Will TA/DA be paid for the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice says no TA/DA will be given.
